description: GOMS MCP unavailable while host alive; use local authority/recovery substrate and machine execution routes. Recovery must not depend on GOMS health.

steps.description: Capture GOMS runtime state: Neo4j status and goms-v2 store health
command: launchctl list | grep -i -e neo4j -e goms || true; tail -20 "$HOME/Library/Logs/neo4j.log" 2>/dev/null || true

steps.description: Verify canonical SQLite GOMS state is present and non-empty
command: ls -la "$HOME/.hermes/goms" 2>/dev/null || ls -la "$HOME/Library/Application Support/goms" 2>/dev/null || echo 'canonical store location differs; consult manifest'

steps.description: Restart Neo4j via brew services (projection only; canonical SQLite untouched)

command: sleep 5; lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -n -P | grep -i neo4j || echo 'neo4j not yet listening'

steps.description: Rebuild the Neo4j projection from canonical SQLite state
command: import sys; print('rebuild via goms MCP graph_rebuild when MCP is healthy; projection-only, canonical SQLite untouched')
